issues.on_page: Support services - student 402,431 = General Fund 168,056 + Other Governmental 234,375 (Activities Fund expenditures, p7/p14)
issues.issue: Most of the line (234,375 of 402,431) is Activities Fund spending, which detail[75] records as student activities. Under the dominant-category rule this could be student activities. Defensible because the report itself groups it under Support services - student, but notes don't mention the mix.

issues.on_page: Contracted or secured services 123,173 (Special Building Fund, p17)
issues.issue: This is Special Building Fund spending (building construction and repair), so Building and Grounds may fit better than generic support services. A review note is present.

issues.on_page: Other local receipts 17,239 = GF 1990 11,350 + Student Fee summer school fees 5,500 + Nutrition 389 (p7, p8, p19)
issues.issue: Of this line, 5,500 is printed as summer school fees (detail[102] is Tuition Received). It could be split out with split_from. Keeping it in other is defensible because the unexplained 11,350 is the majority. A review note is present.

Category 'Debt Service' lines (disbursements[9], [10] and detail Principal/Interest payments) don't have the debt_service_part field that the user rule calls for. The part appears only in detail_category.
Fund balance lines Committed, Assigned and Unassigned (equity[2]-[4]) have no category field, while the Restricted lines do. Amounts tie: 15,333 + 66,282 + 59,696 + 338,073 + 371,508 = 850,892.
